top_signals.title: This Spider-Man Is 'Deeper,' Say Sony's Rothman
top_signals.summary: Sony Pictures Entertainment Motion Picture Group Chairman and CEO Tom Rothman says this latest Spider-Man movie was deeper and more emotional than others in the franchise.  He says "Spider-Man: Brand New Day" could be one of the studio's most profitable movies ever. Rothman also talks about ticket prices and making movies in California on "Bloomberg The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
